flags.observation: Intro never says what we are doing here: no game, cards or wrestling premise; 'kicks out at two' carries the setup unexplained for normies.
Therapist joke lands on billing, yet beside 'Nobody gets cured' it can read as mocking people who seek help.
'Cold logic? Decode:' stacks two openers; 'Decode' bridges nothing, the Hat does not follow from or twist the Alarm Clock.
'Mater comes from Mater, Mother' sounds like one word said twice; the pun is inaudible when spoken.
'Riddle done? Rewind:' repeats the question-plus-command stacked opener cadence of beats 16 and 53; one opener family used three times.
Opener fused into card sentence ('Oedipus did, but Hamlet'); name not first, 104 characters, needs a second breath.
Only 13 openers on 52 card lines (25 percent), below the third-to-half range; beats 36 to 40 run as a bare list.
With 'So you barricade:' the line reaches 104 characters; not sayable in one breath.
'Royal Road' stands without its destination and the slash name is merged; the card's claim blurs for listeners.
'just' in 'the ones you just can't remember' is an added non-card filler word.
Beats 47 to 52 run six cards without opener or bridge; no Therefore/But linkage, the page arc goes flat.
'Spooky? Same cat:' is an unexplained art reference for listeners; 105 characters, longest line, two breaths.
